purpose: Make Pantheon's commercial release boundary inspectable and replaceable: local development packages are explicitly named and non-distributable; only a Developer-ID signed, notarized, stapled, validated route may create the commercial DMG and PKG names.

authority.commercial_release_owner: tagged release workflow plus Developer ID and Apple notarization evidence
prohibited: an unsigned or ad-hoc package cannot use a commercial release filename
a development artifact cannot be uploaded, tagged, or described as released
source/static success cannot claim that signing, notarization, publication, cask lifecycle, or installation occurred

outputs: -dev DMG/PKG names for local package work
commercial DMG/PKG names only in --release mode
writes: transaction-local Pantheon.app, DMG, or PKG only when an explicitly selected build mode is executed
upgrade_recipe: keep modes mutually exclusive and explicit
update the static contract when a packaging entry point changes

inputs: macapp/Package.swift and native Swift menubar source
outputs: one Pantheon.app payload containing CLI, the canonical Swift menubar, LaunchAgent resource, and Stack Lab contracts
writes: build-root Pantheon.app and package staging only
upgrade_recipe: bind every product surface to the same canonical engine
require macapp/Package.swift and fail packaging instead of substituting the retired Go menubar
keep Stack Lab resources in the app payload
verify package identity before broad distribution work
do not execute a candidate payload merely to inventory it

outputs: release workflow artifact names suitable for GitHub and cask binding
writes: signed package bytes and remote release/cask records only under separately authorized credentialed execution
upgrade_recipe: fail before commercial artifact creation when any required credential is absent
staple and validate every commercial payload
treat remote publication and cask lifecycle as separate evidence nodes

inputs: SHA-256 of the uploaded signed DMG
writes: Homebrew tap cask record only in the credentialed tagged-release workflow
upgrade_recipe: render and verify the cask as exact bytes
read back the remote cask and re-verify its release tuple
never derive a cask from a development artifact
